population: 100 assistant-labelled control cases; provisional silver labels, previously visible to assistant, NOT blind human ground truth
input_integrity: Check original frozen SHA-256 for rules, taxonomy, dev and control before running
metrics: priority macro-F1 across all four classes and present classes
human review rate and missed mandatory cases
local HTTP latency including JSON serialization
draft characters and bounded context characters
latency: Nearest-rank p95, three measured sequential localhost HTTP passes over 100 cases after five excluded warmups; cold startup reported separately; no production claim
cost: Only model API charge can be zero in offline template mode; infrastructure and labor costs unmeasured. Missing live usage or prices is null, never zero. No guessed model prices.
blind_review: 100 anonymously shuffled control cases, no labels/version/provenance in reviewer packet, separate coordinator key; correctness, usefulness, language and promises left blank for people

optimization: Before scoring control: four messages of 800 chars, two rule excerpts of 1000 chars, max output tokens 900, two default clarification questions, exact-match verified support templates. No adaptation to control errors.
